hearing_date_given.quote: the respondent, without even affording an opportunity of hearing to the petitioner, passed the impugned order confirming the proposals contained in the show cause notice

service_mode.quote: a show cause notice and all other allied communications were uploaded on the GST on-line portal, under the different column ''View Additional notices/orders''
uploaded the said order on the Gst On-line Portal, which even was unknown to the petitioner

events.quote: impugned order bearing GSTIN 33AJIPD6949E1ZA/19-2020 dated 27.08.2024 along with the summary order Form GST DRC-07 bearing Reference No. ZD330824246308A dated 27.08.2024 passed by the Respondent
only when the bank account of the petitioner came to be attached, the petitioner came to know of the impugned proceedings and challenging the same, the present Writ Petition is filed.

defects_argued.quote: No doubt, sending notice by uploading in portal is a sufficient service, but, the Officer who finds no response from the petitioner to the show cause notices, instead of sending repeated reminders, should have applied his/her mind and explored the possibility of sending notices by way of other modes prescribed in Section 169 of the GST Act, which are also the valid mode of service under the Act, otherwise, the service of notice will not be deemed to be an effective service, rather, it would only fulfilling the empty formalities.
In such circumstances, this Court is of the view that the impugned assessment order came to be passed without affording any opportunity of personal hearing to the petitioner.

outcome.quote: In the result, the Writ Petition is allowed on the aforesaid terms.
